turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All good here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bike's back tire has gone flat again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. You could patch the inner tube yourself tonight, or take it to the shop tomorrow and get a sturdier tire. What would you like to do?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, give me a bit, someone's at my door. Wait quietly until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you know where I put my reading glasses?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: They're on your head.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you look at these two invitation samples for a second?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Oh, the cream one is really pretty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right? But the white one is half the price.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Honestly, nobody keeps the invitation. Go with the cheaper one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mom will notice though. Which font do you like better?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The curly one. The other looks like a business letter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, curly font, white card. Deal.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: When are you back from work tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably around six.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, sorry, I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We were sorting out your flat tire, patching it or taking it in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll patch it, I've got a kit somewhere in the garage.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great. Check the inside of the tire for a thorn first, or it'll go flat again.
